limitations: IBM Model 1 is established prior art, not a novel architecture
Independent token alignment cannot establish contextual word senses, discourse, or historical ancestry
No gold word-alignment references; held-out metric is only a shuffled-pair compatibility control
No word reordering model and no sentence generation
Rare words with fewer than three source groups excluded; Urdu coverage limited
A probability is a learned conditional association, not factual confidence
